description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting North Pole Patrol.
If Forensic Researcher has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
If North Pole Patrol has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.

uses.name: Hawkeye's Bow
uses.cardState: attached to either Forensic Researcher or North Pole Patrol
